headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: the inaugural ROH World TV Title was crowned as Samoa Joe vs. Minoru Suzuki went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.74 ? a good, competitive contest. A dream match between two legendary hard-hitters ? a chop-and-forearm war that had the crowd chanting in approval, ending with Joe capturing a title that had eluded him throughout his whole career.
Looking back to 2024, when AZM laced up for their first AEW match against Toni Storm, appearing on Collision, rated 6.88.

2022 brought us this moment: Jurassic Express vs. reDRagon went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.45 ? a match that delivered. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2024, Andretti, Dante & Sydal stepped through the curtain for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.90.
Flash back to 2022, when Lee & Strickland touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.61 ? a strong outing.
2022 brought us this moment: Jake Hager was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
